basis: Machine spot-check, not a human page-turn. All 45 records in extract.jsonl were verified programmatically: each quote was matched as an exact substring (after whitespace and curly-quote normalisation) of the chunk file its page maps to, so zero quotes are paraphrased and zero page attributions are guessed. The 5 ids listed are a stratified sample across the chapter — one per major section — re-read by eye against chunks/0002.txt, 0004.txt, 0006.txt and 0007.txt and against the 0008 closing commentary. `by: Ash` records the PM as signer of the lock; it does NOT assert that the PM personally re-opened the PDF, and the confirmed count rests on the verbatim substring proof plus that eye re-read, which is the strongest basis available in this build.
